fields.System.Title: INB-210 — Perform a blind receipt with no ASN
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want to receive a delivery that nobody told us about, so that
an unannounced truck can be unloaded instead of turned away.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given no matching ASN, when I start a blind receipt, then I can record supplier,
  • reference, products, and quantities.
  • - Given a blind receipt, then supervisor approval is required before confirmation.
  • - Given the system finds a plausible matching ASN or purchase order, then it offers the
  • match and the receipt becomes a normal one if accepted.
  • - Given no match, then stock is created in quarantine, not available.
  • - Given a blind receipt, then an exception record is raised for purchasing to resolve.
  • - Given a similar receipt from the same supplier within 48 hours, then a possible
  • duplicate is flagged.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | receipt, receipt_line, stock_balance |
| Risks | Duplicate when the ASN arrives later; blind receipt used to bypass controls ([doc 05 WF 2](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
